text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One morning on a day off…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Just like that! Take that! And that!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: VICTORY! This week's episode of Princess Fighter was awesome!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It happens every time I watch, but I just can't contain the desire to jump up and get moving! I want to do battle against ne'er-do-wells right now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I know what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: After watching an exciting movie or reading a great book, I often find myself wanting to recreate great scenes from them!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I don't care if it makes me a copycat! I'll do what I want to do!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And who knows? This new experience could become a spark that leads to me discovering a new side of myself!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Now, I must go bust something up to release all this energy! RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Princess Fighter's Princess Sky Step technique was really incredible…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: One quick burst forward, and she was gliding gracefully. It was almost as if she was running on air…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps as a result of her newfound inspiration, Nishino Flower's movements become sharper than ever.
